name: Imazu 07 -- overtaking (own-ship give-way) + crossing from starboard (2 targets)
own_ship_role: give-way (overtaking) to ts1 / give-way to ts2
description: Canonical Imazu problem 7 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/07/07.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 is a slower target ahead that own-ship must overtake; ts2 crosses from starboard (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship keeps clear of the slower target it is overtaking and does not cut in front until finally past and clear.
Own-ship gives way early and substantially (normally to starboard) for the target(s) crossing from starboard, and avoids crossing ahead if circumstances allow.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
